title: SIP: add a preference to set default charset in raw text view
description:
## Summary

Add the "Default charset of raw SIP messages" preference to set default charset for displaying the body of SIP messages in raw text view.

## Issue

After MR !10021 is merged, the GB18030 characters in XML (with encoding="GB18080" attribute) of a SIP message body can be displayed correctly (by XML dissector). But it can't display correctly in the SIP raw text view (because content added line by line by data-text-lines dissector instead of xml dissector):

![SIP_raw_display_incorrectly](/uploads/0407ae500cceea6fac62fb06585ef428/SIP_raw_display_incorrectly.png)

Similar, the GB18030 characters in XML without encoding="GB18080" attribute of a SIP message body can also be displayed correctly by setting the 'Default charset encoding' preference of XML dissector to "GB18080". But they can't be displayed correctly in the SIP raw text view:

![SIP_raw_display_incorrectly_without_encoding](/uploads/be13620993e5286df4a7d0741b9f440d/SIP_raw_display_incorrectly_without_encoding.png)

## Solution

The "Default charset of raw SIP messages" preference of SIP dissector is added to set default charset for displaying the body of SIP messages in raw text view.

After this MR was applied and the "Default charset of raw SIP messages" preference of SIP dissector set to "GB18030", both cases mentioned above will be fixed:

![SIP_raw_display_correctly_without_encoding](/uploads/8ed979fc272c373d21ed0e87a5e0ea24/SIP_raw_display_correctly_without_encoding.png)

## Sample Capture Files

[sip_xml_body.pcapng](/uploads/3f4b6380b07168b5b137bfe2a726753a/sip_xml_body.pcapng)

[sip_xml_body_without_encoding.pcapng](/uploads/60e454963c7038668d669a1cc185cb5b/sip_xml_body_without_encoding.pcapng)
